summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Duncanville, Texas. It describes Duncanville as a city in southern Dallas County, Texas, and gives its 2010 census population. It also places the city within the Best Southwest area alongside Cedar Hill, DeSoto, and Lancaster.
one_line: Duncanville is a city in southern Dallas County, Texas, with a 2010 population of 38,524, part of the Best Southwest area.
key_facts: Duncanville is a city in southern Dallas County, Texas, in the United States.
Duncanville's population was 38,524 at the 2010 census.
The city is part of the Best Southwest area.
The Best Southwest area includes Duncanville, Cedar Hill, DeSoto, and Lancaster.
